22. QA vs QC vs testing

QA focuses on improving processes to prevent defects; QC evaluates product quality; testing is one
QC technique.
QA එJකන් process එක improve කරලා defects අඩු කරනවා. QC එJකන් product quality බලනවා.
Review acceptance criteria, inspect a release, and run checkout tests.

QA: prevent · QC: evaluate · Testing: execute / assess · Read the diagram: QA: prevent / QC: evaluate / Testing: execute / assess. · QA එJකන් process එක improve කරලා defects අඩු කරනවා. QC එJකන් product quality බලනවා. Testing · එJකන් behavior verify කරනවා.
Expected result: Different activities contribute to quality; responsibility belongs to the whole team.

Q: Is QA only testing?
A: No. It includes process improvement and prevention.
